stem: Which of these counts toward the May 2026 MRR of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices?

options.text: €45 from a business whose plan ended on 30 April and was not renewed
€40 a month from a Business Care Year business that paid €480 in January for the whole year
A €99 one-off setup fee that a new business paid when it joined in May
